# 120.00 USD parked in a USD account, against the 100.00 invoice.
#
# The same shape as `more_money_booked_to_a_usd_account.txt` but with
# its own guids, so a test can swap the two sides of the link on it: the
# overpayment arm is what takes a file past the guards installed after it, and
# the swap is the mistake those guards exist to catch.
#
# What this fixture produces: a USD transaction, bank +120.00 against suspense
# −120.00, neither split in a lot.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
